    LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.pairCoveringData

    Covering data from a convex piece of the universal cover #

    If A ≅ k(P) for a finite ray category P whose fundamental group is torsion-free (free, by Bongartz's Theorem 2), a Kronecker pair on a finite convex piece S of the universal cover whose two generating modules respect the relations of the cover gives covering data with a Kronecker pair for A (RayCat.pairCoveringData). This reduces alternative (2′) of Theorem 3.10 to a statement about P̃.
